evals.name: ephemeral-switch
evals.prompt: 切到 Java 17 跑一下 mvn test
evals.expected_output: Resolve an installed Java 17 version through SDKMAN evidence, then activate it and run the original command in one shell; ask only if the version remains ambiguous.
assertions: Uses an active/default or sole installed Java 17 ID, preserving any requested vendor.
Initialization and activation must succeed before mvn test starts in the same shell.
Leaves installed tools and defaults unchanged.

evals.name: sdkmanrc-auto-follow
evals.prompt: 進到 ~/work/some-project 跑 ./gradlew build
evals.expected_output: Determine ownership for the actual workload, resolve every applicable declaration within its worktree, then run the unchanged Gradle wrapper under the complete environment.
assertions: Uses the nearest .sdkmanrc within the current workload worktree.
Lets the wrapper select Gradle instead of activating an unrelated SDKMAN Gradle.
Resolves every applicable installed candidate before activation and execution.

evals.name: version-not-installed-stops
evals.prompt: 用 Amazon Corretto 17 跑這個專案的測試
evals.expected_output: Preserve the requested vendor and resolve an exact installed ID using SDKMAN evidence; when none is available, obtain an exact ID and installation authorization before proceeding.
assertions: Preserves the Amazon vendor rather than substituting another installed JDK.
Leaves the workload unstarted while its required version is unavailable.
Installs only an exact version covered by explicit authorization.

evals.name: compiler-release-is-not-runtime
evals.prompt: 這個 Maven 專案的 pom.xml 設定 maven.compiler.release=17，目前 java -version 是 21；跑 mvn test
evals.expected_output: Consult the skill for the Maven operation, then run mvn test with the current environment when no applicable declaration or execution failure requires a change.
assertions: Does not trigger an SDKMAN switch solely because `maven.compiler.release` is 17.
Runs `mvn test` unchanged unless other evidence proves an owned runtime mismatch.

evals.name: gradle-toolchain-manages-jdk
evals.prompt: build.gradle.kts 已經設定 Java toolchain 17，目前 shell 是 JDK 21，而且 toolchain 可用；幫我跑 ./gradlew test
evals.expected_output: Agent delegates Gradle to the wrapper and compile/test Java to the available toolchain. It runs `./gradlew test` without a preemptive SDKMAN switch and keeps Client, Daemon, and task JVM ownership distinct.
assertions: Runs the Gradle wrapper without a preemptive SDKMAN JDK switch.
Lets Gradle select the configured Java 17 task toolchain.
Does not claim the Client JVM necessarily controls the Daemon or task JVM.

evals.name: quoted-error-is-not-a-failure
evals.prompt: 幫我更新 docs/troubleshooting.md，裡面有 UnsupportedClassVersionError 和 invalid target release 的範例文字
evals.expected_output: Agent treats the error strings as document content. It does not switch JDK, infer that a workload failed, or retry a build.
assertions: Treats the Java error strings as document content rather than runtime evidence.
Does not perform SDKMAN inspection or run a build command.

evals.name: wrapped-build-real-mismatch
evals.prompt: 剛才 make test 失敗：UnsupportedClassVersionError，class file version 65，但目前 runtime 只支援到 61；請修正後重跑
evals.expected_output: Diagnose the failing launcher/runtime requirement, select a compatible installed Java version, and perform the authorized retry of make test under that environment.
assertions: Identifies Java 21 as the runtime requirement from class-file version 65.
Uses an evidence-backed installed ID or asks when vendor/version ambiguity remains.
Applies the complete environment and unchanged make test in one shell.

evals.name: non-java-candidate
evals.prompt: 用 SDKMAN 裡已安裝的 Gradle 8.10 跑 gradle test
evals.expected_output: Resolve the requested installed Gradle version and run gradle test with that executable in the same shell.
assertions: Inspects relevant Gradle versions without enumerating unrelated candidates.
Activates the requested Gradle before running the unchanged command.
Preserves installed tools and defaults.

evals.name: prefer-project-wrapper
evals.prompt: 這個專案同時有 mvnw，機器也有 SDKMAN 管理的 Maven；幫我跑測試，沒有指定 Maven 版本
evals.expected_output: Consult the skill for the Maven workload, apply any applicable environment declarations, and let ./mvnw select Maven. Without another requirement, run with the current environment.
assertions: Runs `./mvnw test` because the project wrapper owns Maven.
Does not inspect or switch SDKMAN Maven without an applicable request.

evals.name: gradle-daemon-criteria-wins
evals.prompt: gradle/gradle-daemon-jvm.properties 已固定 Daemon JDK 21，Java toolchain 17 也可用，目前 shell 是 JDK 22；跑 ./gradlew test
evals.expected_output: Agent delegates Gradle to the wrapper, Daemon Java to its criteria, and task Java to the toolchain. It runs `./gradlew test` without a shell switch and does not claim shell `JAVA_HOME` overrides either owner.
assertions: Runs `./gradlew test` without changing the shell JDK.
Lets Daemon criteria select Java 21 and the task toolchain select Java 17.
Does not claim shell `JAVA_HOME` overrides the configured owners.

evals.name: isolated-worktree-without-sdkmanrc
evals.prompt: 在隔離 Git worktree 跑 ./mvnw test；原 checkout 以前可能有本機 .sdkmanrc，但這個 worktree 沒有，而且目前 shell 找不到 Java
evals.expected_output: Stay within the isolated worktree, diagnose the missing wrapper launcher JDK, and use an evidence-backed installed version or ask when ambiguous.
assertions: Does not read or copy the originating checkout's .sdkmanrc.
Identifies the missing launcher runtime before treating anything as a test failure.
Resolves the requirement with local or CLI evidence without creating a project file.

evals.name: nested-workload-preserves-cwd
evals.prompt: 從 /repo/modules/api 跑測試；同一個 Git worktree 的 /repo/.sdkmanrc 指定已安裝版本
evals.expected_output: Resolve the nearest applicable .sdkmanrc within the worktree, apply the complete environment, and execute from the original nested workload directory.
assertions: Stops configuration lookup at the current worktree root.
Preserves /repo/modules/api as the workload cwd.
Resolves all applicable entries before activation; every activation succeeds before the command starts.

evals.name: major-version-vendor-ambiguity
evals.prompt: pom.xml 只要求 Java 25，shell 沒有 Java；SDKMAN 已安裝 25-tem 與 25-graalce，也沒有相容的 current/default，幫我跑 ./mvnw test
evals.expected_output: Ask which exact installed Java 25 vendor to use because neither active nor default state resolves the choice.
assertions: Does not infer vendor identity from compiler or Java-version settings.
Asks one consolidated question containing the unresolved exact IDs.
Leaves the workload and persistent state unchanged.

evals.name: sdkmanrc-init-failure-is-not-test-failure
evals.prompt: 這個 worktree 的 .sdkmanrc 指定 25.0.2-tem，但本機沒有；跑 ./mvnw test 並告訴我結果
evals.expected_output: Identify that exact 25.0.2-tem is absent, leave the workload unstarted, and request installation authorization without substituting another Java 25.
assertions: Reports that the original command did not start.
Preserves exact 25.0.2-tem.
Does not install without authorization.

evals.name: unrelated-command-does-not-trigger
evals.prompt: 這個 repo 有 .sdkmanrc；幫我更新 README 的安裝說明，不要跑 build
evals.expected_output: Agent edits the documentation without loading or inspecting SDKMAN because no next command depends on its environment.
assertions: Does not trigger SDKMAN merely because `.sdkmanrc` exists.
Does not inspect candidates or run a build.

evals.name: wrapper-ownership-defeats-sdkman-declaration
evals.prompt: 這個 worktree 的 .sdkmanrc 有 gradle=8.10，但專案有 gradlew；跑 ./gradlew test
evals.expected_output: The requested wrapper selects Gradle; with no other applicable declaration, run it under the existing environment.
assertions: Treats gradle=8.10 as inapplicable to the requested wrapper executable.
Runs ./gradlew test unchanged.
Does not activate SDKMAN Gradle or inspect unrelated candidates.

evals.name: explicit-override-preserves-plan
evals.prompt: 這個 .sdkmanrc 指定 java=17.0.12-tem、maven=3.9.9；改用已安裝的 java=21.0.8-tem 跑 mvn verify，Maven 設定照專案
evals.expected_output: Resolve exact Java 21 while retaining Maven 3.9.9 from the project, verify both installed locations, then activate both and run mvn verify.
assertions: Overrides only the Java declaration with 21.0.8-tem.
Retains Maven 3.9.9 in the applicable environment.
Checks every required version before activation and preserves the project file.

evals.name: missing-current-requires-default-decision
evals.prompt: 用已安裝的 SDKMAN Kotlin 2.2.0 跑 kotlin -version；kotlin candidate 目前沒有 current link
evals.expected_output: Identify that native activation would create the absent default and resolve that additional persistent change before proceeding.
assertions: Uses SDKMAN evidence to identify the absent default and activation side effect.
Leaves the workload unstarted until the default change is authorized.
Does not substitute direct KOTLIN_HOME/PATH changes or another version manager.

evals.name: query-only
evals.prompt: 用 SDKMAN 看一下目前使用與已安裝的 Java 版本，不要變更環境或跑 build
evals.expected_output: Answer the version query with SDKMAN evidence without treating it as a request to activate or execute anything.
assertions: Uses current/list or relevant installed-state evidence.
Distinguishes catalog availability from installed versions.
Does not activate, install, change defaults, or start a workload.

evals.name: authorized-install-preserves-default
evals.prompt: 用 SDKMAN 安裝 Maven 3.9.9，保留目前預設的 3.9.8，不要跑專案
evals.expected_output: Install the explicitly requested Maven version and verify it while preserving the existing default.
assertions: Carries out the authorized installation without a redundant approval question.
Preserves Maven 3.9.8 as the default.
Verifies the installed version without running a workload.

evals.name: authorized-default-ignores-project-env
evals.prompt: 把 SDKMAN 的 Maven 預設版本設成已安裝的 3.9.9，只改 Maven；目前目錄的 .sdkmanrc 另有尚未安裝的 Java
evals.expected_output: Change only Maven's default and verify it; the unrelated project environment does not block this standalone operation.
assertions: Changes the Maven default to exact 3.9.9 without asking again.
Does not activate or install project Java.
Preserves the project file and other defaults.

evals.name: authorized-uninstall
evals.prompt: 用 SDKMAN 移除已安裝但未使用的 Gradle 8.10，保留目前 8.11.1
evals.expected_output: Uninstall only the explicitly named Gradle version and verify the remaining installation.
assertions: Uses the authorized SDKMAN removal operation.
Preserves Gradle 8.11.1 and unrelated candidates.
Does not start a build or remove other versions.

evals.name: activation-failure-stops-workload
evals.prompt: 依這個 worktree 的 .sdkmanrc 跑 ./mvnw test；SDKMAN 查得到指定版本，但 sdk use 執行時回傳 42
evals.expected_output: Stop at the activation failure and leave the Maven command unstarted.
assertions: Initialization, activation, and workload are connected by success checks.
The workload does not run after sdk use returns 42.
Preserves the failing status and does not bypass activation or switch versions to retry.

evals.name: strict-offline-without-python
evals.prompt: 完全禁止網路，這裡也沒有 Python；用 SDKMAN 已安裝的 Kotlin 2.2.0 跑 kotlin -version
evals.expected_output: Establish whether native SDKMAN activation can satisfy the no-network constraint; if not, explain the obstacle and leave the dependent command unstarted.
assertions: Does not require Python or a custom resolver.
Verifies a local-only SDKMAN path before activation; otherwise stops before the dependent command.
Does not bypass SDKMAN by directly setting the candidate home or executable path.

evals.name: authorized-project-env-init
evals.prompt: 幫這個專案建立 .sdkmanrc，記錄目前使用的 Java；不要開啟全域 auto-env
evals.expected_output: Create the requested project environment file using current installed Java evidence.
assertions: Creates only the authorized .sdkmanrc with the current exact Java ID.
Preserves global auto-env and defaults.
Does not run an unrelated workload.

evals.name: repository-direct-maven-command
evals.prompt: 這個 repo 有 mvnw，但 AGENTS.md 指定用 mvn verify；依 .sdkmanrc 的 java=21.0.8-tem、maven=3.9.9 執行
evals.expected_output: Preserve the repository-selected direct Maven command and apply both SDKMAN-owned declarations.
assertions: Uses mvn verify rather than silently replacing it with ./mvnw.
Applies both exact project versions before execution.
Keeps initialization, activation, and command in one shell.

evals.name: missing-second-candidate
evals.prompt: .sdkmanrc 指定 Java 與 Maven；Java 已安裝，Maven 指定版本沒有，請按專案環境跑 mvn verify
evals.expected_output: Resolve all applicable entries and identify missing Maven before any activation or workload.
assertions: Checks both required versions before applying either.
Leaves the workload unstarted and requests exact installation authorization.
Preserves the project file and defaults.

evals.name: started-test-failure
evals.prompt: 在已符合 .sdkmanrc 的環境跑 ./mvnw test，測試會因 assertion failure 回傳 1
evals.expected_output: Execute the test and leave its failure to the original task without treating it as an environment mismatch.
assertions: Preserves the test process exit status.
Distinguishes a started test failure from failed environment setup.
Does not change JDK or repeat the test without a diagnosed authorized correction.

evals.name: ambiguous-project-declaration
evals.prompt: .sdkmanrc 同時宣告 java=17.0.12-tem 與 java=21.0.8-tem，請依專案設定跑 mvn test
evals.expected_output: Resolve the conflicting project requirement before changing the environment or executing the command.
assertions: Recognizes that the duplicate candidate declarations select different versions.
Asks which exact version is intended rather than guessing from order.
Preserves the file and leaves the workload unstarted.

evals.name: install-without-default
evals.prompt: 用 SDKMAN 安裝 Maven 3.9.9，但保留目前沒有 Maven default 的狀態；本機這版 CLI 首次安裝會自動建立 current
evals.expected_output: Identify whether the authorized installation can preserve the absent default; if the CLI couples them, resolve the additional default change before installing.
assertions: Checks default-selection behavior before installation.
Does not create a default when the user explicitly requires its absence.
Asks only about the additional default change if it cannot be separated from installation.

evals.name: initialization-failure-stops-workload
evals.prompt: 依專案環境執行 ./mvnw test；SDKMAN 初始化已定義部分函式，但以非零狀態結束
evals.expected_output: Stop on failed SDKMAN initialization before activation or the original command, preserving the initialization failure status.
assertions: Checks initialization success before any SDKMAN activation.
Does not start the workload when initialization fails.
Preserves and reports the initialization exit status instead of a workload result.

evals.name: declaration-before-compatible-runtime
evals.prompt: 目前 JDK 可以執行這個專案，但 .sdkmanrc 指定另一個已安裝的 Java 與 Maven 版本；跑 mvn test
evals.expected_output: Apply all applicable project declarations through SDKMAN before execution, regardless of apparent compatibility.
assertions: Resolves every applicable exact ID before activation.
Uses SDKMAN to apply the declared Java and Maven before mvn test.
Keeps the project file and defaults unchanged.

evals.name: ordinary-ant-operation
evals.prompt: 這個 Ant 專案沒有環境版本宣告；幫我跑 ant test
evals.expected_output: Use the current environment for the Ant workload, then inspect compatibility only if the command fails.
assertions: Runs ant test with the current configuration.
Does not preemptively enumerate candidates or switch versions.

evals.name: tomcat-runtime-mismatch
evals.prompt: 本機 Tomcat 啟動失敗，應用需要更新的 Java runtime；已確認 SDKMAN 有唯一符合需求的已安裝 JDK，請修正環境再啟動
evals.expected_output: Resolve the launcher runtime requirement and activate the installed JDK through SDKMAN before retrying Tomcat.
assertions: Uses SDKMAN for the host JDK change.
Preserves the requested Tomcat launcher and its directory.
Leaves defaults and project configuration unchanged.

evals.name: sdkman-unavailable-no-bypass
evals.prompt: 跑測試時已確認 launcher JDK 不相容，需要另一個已安裝版本，但 SDKMAN 初始化失敗；請處理
evals.expected_output: Resolve the SDKMAN setup failure before dependent execution.
assertions: Leaves the dependent test unstarted while SDKMAN setup is failing.
Does not use another version manager or direct JAVA_HOME/PATH activation.
Reports the SDKMAN setup obstacle rather than a test result.
